Coram : TARUN CHATTERJEE*, H.S. BEDI
Transfer of Property - Transfer of land with possession - By a Bhumidhar - Against a loan - Execution of Mortgage deed - Transferer filing suit seeking redemption of the c mortgage - Trial Court as well as first and second appellate courts finding that the transaction was in fact a sale and not a lost the right of redemption - Apart from concurrent finding that the transaction was a sale, even by virtue of s. 164 of Zamindari D Abolition Act, such transaction would be deemed to be a sale to the transferee - Uttar Pradesh Zaminidari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1951 - s. 164 -
Decision Date : 14-03-2008 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 4125/2001 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
